sources.title: Blickhan, Full and Ting1993 — Exoskeletal strain and ghost-crab gait transition
sources.scope: Selected biological introduction/methods pages301–303 distinguish eight-legged low-speed support from variable fast gaits and report actual O.quadrata subjects. No strains, muscle properties, frequencies or high-speed gait transferred to the authored slow study.

retrieval.accessMethod: Author-lab PDF download; selected text read, actual page303 rendered/viewed

sources.title: Virginia Institute of Marine Science — ocypodid crabs
sources.scope: Institutional shore/burrowing/ecology account. Its heading spelling quadrate is not adopted as a replacement for accepted Ocypode quadrata. Burrowing, sound and visual sensitivity are context, not simulated processes.

sources.title: Smithsonian NMNH — Ocypode quadrata collection record91229
sources.scope: Indexed collection metadata identifies preserved juvenile males collected1966 in Dominica. Direct retrieval returned404. This is distinct from the live Costa Rica reference, not a determination of it. Metadata CC0 does not grant image reuse; no restricted Smithsonian image imported.

retrieval.accessMethod: Indexed record metadata only; direct page request failed

shape.before: The earlier withheld oval/rod-limbed draft is preserved on the body sheet.
shape.changed: A high quadrangular shell and continuous lateral wall, large dark elongated eye ends on thicker unhorned stalks, asymmetric cream chelae, eight flattened articulated limbs and curved terminal points replace the generic oval and needle appendages.
shape.remaining: The frontal/orbital region, stridulating ridges, gill chambers, buccal plates and ventral details remain incomplete. Eye and limb proportions, granule density, wetness and sand-dependent coloration are unmeasured. The selected quiet pose does not reproduce the photo's body tilt or its burrow context.

surface.changed: Sandy yellow cuticle, restrained pale variation, fine granules and leg-edge setae are original numerical surfaces retained through movement.
surface.remaining: Original numerical illustration, without calibrated optics, scan or full natural variation. The frontal/orbital region, stridulating ridges, gill chambers, buccal plates and ventral details remain incomplete. Eye and limb proportions, granule density, wetness and sand-dependent coloration are unmeasured. The selected quiet pose does not reproduce the photo's body tilt or its burrow context.

movement.changed: Short authored lateral support/recovery bout, local chela/antennule handling, finger opening, quiet support and neutral reset retain the same body. No sprint, burrowing or strain/muscle simulation.
movement.remaining: No measured coordinates, natural playback rate, joint limits, forces, fluid dynamics, muscle, food contact, ingestion, sensory physiology or independent biological validation. Fixed-length/support checks establish internal software consistency only.

sourceAssessment: Selected Blickhan,Full&Ting1993 introduction/methods and actual printed303 figure were read/viewed for O.quadrata gait context. Only a slow eight-legged authored study is implemented, without transferring sister-species sprint physiology. Hans Hillewaert's living Costa Rica photo was viewed. Smithsonian juvenile preserved-specimen metadata is contextual; direct page404 and image reuse restrictions remain disclosed.
fixesAfterRenderedReview: Shortened and thickened overly thin eye stalks after frontal comparison.
Removed block-like front plates and joined the shell perimeter with a curved sidewall.
Retained eight slow walking supports and avoided a fabricated sprint or horned-eye phenotype.

assessmentRubric.identity: Accepted species-rank concept checked; photographed organism remains source-labelled
assessmentRubric.body: Substantial initial correction; unmeasured dimensions and incomplete fine diagnostic anatomy
assessmentRubric.texture: Distinct selected numerical surface; optics and microanatomy remain illustrative
assessmentRubric.movement: Working qualitative supported articulation; empirical rate/dynamics unvalidated
